execution.raw_text: {"up_exec":"Return the first 200 metabolism records for the organism 'Callithrix jacchus' where the substrate compound has a known canonical SMILES. For each row, select canonical_smiles, the substrate compound name (aliased as substrate_compound_name), the parent compound preferred name (aliased as parent_compound_name), met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id, then to compound_structures on molregno, and left-join through molecule_hierarchy to molecule_dictionary to resolve the parent compound name. Do not add an ORDER BY clause; just return the first 200 rows."}

parsed_json.up_exec: Return the first 200 metabolism records for the organism 'Callithrix jacchus' where the substrate compound has a known canonical SMILES. For each row, select canonical_smiles, the substrate compound name (aliased as substrate_compound_name), the parent compound preferred name (aliased as parent_compound_name), met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id, then to compound_structures on molregno, and left-join through molecule_hierarchy to molecule_dictionary to resolve the parent compound name. Do not add an ORDER BY clause; just return the first 200 rows.
